decisions.reason: As a close-to-core delivery offer in a growing market, it is likely to remain unless overlap with the firm's other express programs leaves it clearly below aspiration.
The seventy-two-hour promise is strategically attractive but operationally demanding, so a large firm with some slack will likely keep testing it unless service or margin results disappoint.
This safety-focused door fits the firm's established technical strengths and regulated customer needs, making it likely to meet aspirations and stay in the range.
A dedicated express line with several models and its own page suggests stronger commitment and enough expected demand for management to retain it.
The digital platform supports the firm's move toward deeper advisory and service integration, so despite adoption uncertainty it is likely to be kept while the firm has slack.

Fire and smoke protection doors are a natural extension of the firm's compliance-oriented portfolio, so management is likely to continue offering them unless early sales lag clearly behind aspiration.
